name: Glimpse
summary: Eleven-page marketing analytics portal for agencies: website, ads, SEO, social and email per client
about: A marketing dashboard for agencies and growth teams that puts website, ads, search rankings, social and email results for each client in one place. Switch client and every page re-runs on that client's numbers. It works as a client portal, with a live visitor map, a report builder and a team list, in a daylight and a night theme.
how: Pick a client from the button at the top; the whole portal swaps to that client's data.
On Overview, watch visits ping on the live map, and switch 7D, 30D or 90D to morph the charts and KPIs.
Acquisition has sessions by source and a campaign link builder you can copy from. Funnel shows drop-off by device.
Ads lists campaigns with on/off switches, sorting and a drawer to change the daily budget. Keywords tracks search positions; add or remove keywords.
Reports builds a client report from the sections you tick, downloads a CSV or schedules it by email.
Clients and Settings add or edit clients, invite or remove teammates, switch the theme and reset the demo data. Ctrl+K searches everything.
